purpose: quantify the gap between the expectation of realized directional throughput and the directional throughput of the expected net schedule

quantities.A_expectation_of_realized_throughput: sum_{s_m,s_o} pi_m*pi_o * sum_p ( eff_ch * shared_es_pch[e,s_m,s_o,p] * dt + shared_es_pdch[e,s_m,s_o,p] * dt / eff_dch )
quantities.B_throughput_of_expected_schedule: sum_p ( eff_ch * pch_hat[p] * dt + pdch_hat[p] * dt / eff_dch ), where pch_hat/pdch_hat are the ESSO's directional decomposition of expected_shared_ess_p[p] = sum_{s_m,s_o} pi_m*pi_o*shared_es_pnet[e,s_m,s_o,p]
quantities.discrepancy: A - B, reported absolutely, relative to A, and as equivalent full cycles via 2*cl_nom*E_rated

sign_expectation.claim: A >= B, with equality iff no period has scenarios of opposing dispatch sign

derivation.setup: Fix a period p. Let X_s = shared_es_pch[e,s,p] >= 0 and Y_s = shared_es_pdch[e,s,p] >= 0 be the per-scenario directional powers, and N = E[X - Y] the coordinated expected net power that the ESSO receives. The ESSO's decomposition satisfies x_hat - y_hat = N together with its complementarity row, so x_hat = max(N,0) and y_hat = max(-N,0) up to the tolerance.
derivation.case_N_nonnegative: B_p = eff_ch * N = eff_ch * (E[X] - E[Y]) <= eff_ch * E[X] <= eff_ch * E[X] + E[Y]/eff_dch = A_p
derivation.case_N_negative: B_p = |N| / eff_dch = (E[Y] - E[X]) / eff_dch <= E[Y] / eff_dch <= A_p
derivation.root_cause: For nonnegative X, Y: |E[X - Y]| <= E[X + Y]. Per-scenario complementarity makes X + Y = |X - Y| within each realization, so this is exactly |E[z]| <= E[|z|] for the signed per-scenario dispatch z. Opposite-sign dispatch CANCELS in the expectation of the net and ADDS in the expectation of the throughput; that cancellation is the whole discrepancy.
derivation.equality_condition: Equality holds iff, in every period, no scenario dispatches against the sign of the expected net - i.e. the minority-direction expectation is zero. Efficiencies do not affect the equality condition: eff_ch and eff_dch appear identically on both sides when only one direction is active.
assumptions: (i) per-scenario network complementarity holds at tolerance: model_construction_helpers.py:836-838, shared_es_pch_hat * shared_es_pdch_hat <= ESS_COMPLEMENTARITY_TOLERANCE
(ii) the ESSO decomposition satisfies its complementarity rows at tolerance with NO active slack: shared_energy_storage_data.py:569 and :618-620

violation_rule.supersedes_v1_rule: v1 said: report any violation as a defect in the diagnostic, not a finding. That rule is wrong in one case and would have concealed it.
violation_rule.rule: If assumptions (i) and (iii) hold and assumption (ii) is VERIFIED to hold with no active slack, then A < B is a defect in the diagnostic and must be reported as such. If slack_es_ch_comp_per_unit (shared_energy_storage_data.py:569) is ACTIVE, x_hat and y_hat may both be strictly positive, B may exceed A, and A < B is then a genuine FINDING - evidence of complementarity slack absorbing directional inconsistency - and must be reported with the active slack values and their PENALTY_ESSO_SLACK contribution to gross_operational_cost.
violation_rule.obligation: the diagnostic must record the slack activity alongside every A/B pair; a discrepancy reported without it is uninterpretable
